description: backend/app/documents.py: POST /documents (multipart upload: pdf/md/txt, max size 5 MB by configurable constant), stores content via a StorageBackend abstraction (LocalDirectoryStorage for dev with tmp-dir tests; S3-storage stub documented, not integration-tested in MVP), persists a document registry as a JSON index (id, filename, sha256, size, uploaded_at, duplicate flag) and GET /documents list returning metadata; duplicate uploads with the same sha256 return the existing document record with duplicate=true and do not create registry copies. Routes registered on the main FastAPI app in backend/app/main.py via include_router; multipart upload requires python-multipart pinned in backend/pyproject.toml. Local-first, tests offline with tmp dirs (no network).
acceptance_criteria: POST /documents accepts pdf/md/txt, rejects unsupported extensions (400) and over-cap size (413), returns document id and metadata
GET /documents lists registered documents with metadata including sha256 and duplicate flag; identical sha256 re-upload is deduplicated (no new registry entry, duplicate=true response)
StorageBackend abstraction interface with LocalDirectoryStorage implementation covered by tmp-dir tests (content stored and retrievable; registry JSON persisted)
S3 storage stub documented in README but not required to be integration-tested in MVP
Deterministic test suite passes offline via python -m unittest discover -s tests -v from backend/ (and pytest); java-free, network-free
python-multipart added as pinned dependency in backend/pyproject.toml and documented in backend/README Setup note

planning.title: Document upload API with storage abstraction
